posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
Feels awkward, having read the official announcement of arenson9 and Rabit becoming new forum moderators, which includes a call to welcome them, but since you can’t reply to posts in the Announcements thread, we can’t actually welcome them there. And there it is again in the News, a call to welcome, but we can’t reply to that so the new moderators remain tragically unwelcomed. And they’re digging right in, reorganizing the forum and presumably moderating the heck out of the forums as we speak, yet they remain unwelcomed!

I can’t take it anymore. Welcome, arenson9 and Rabit. I’m sure you guys will be awesome forum moderators.
posts.raw:

And there it is again in the News, a call to welcome, but we can't reply to that so the new moderators remain tragically unwelcomed.  And they're digging right in, reorganizing the forum and presumably moderating the heck out of the forums as we speak, [i]yet they remain unwelcomed![/i]

I can't take it anymore.  Welcome, arenson9 and Rabit.  I'm sure you guys will be awesome forum moderators. :)

At any rate, thanks for agreeing to an otherwise thankless job, guys.

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Thanks, guys. Our aim is to support the community, including helping everyone enjoy using the forum.

I did suggest having an Events section (and credit to the person (kirioni) who suggested that to me), but the reorg is, as I see it, a nod to the fact that >G is about more than just one game! Much for all of us to look forward to.

ALSO, let’s take a moment to enjoy the fact that the main reason there are now moderators is that >G has so much going on that they don’t have the time to moderate themselves anymore. That’s a GOOD thing.
posts.raw:
Thanks, guys. Our aim is to support the community, including helping everyone enjoy using the forum.

I did suggest having an Events section (and credit to the person (kirioni) who suggested that to _me_), but the reorg is, as I see it, a nod to the fact that >G is about more than just one game! Much for all of us to look forward to.

ALSO, let's take a moment to enjoy the fact that the main reason there are now moderators is that >G has so much going on that they don't have the _time_ to moderate themselves anymore. That's a _GOOD_ thing.
